subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this umbrella stay open until the guarded retention cleanup and default-off cadence guardrail decisions settle, or should maintainers split or reject the remaining context-warning and cadence-policy slices now?
rationale: The retention failure is source-reproducible, but the full request spans compatibility-sensitive session cleanup and a new operator config policy that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Through Linked PR Decisions
options.body: Keep #38730 open while maintainers decide #90194 and #89739, then narrow or close the umbrella based on what lands.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Now
options.body: Move retention, cadence limits, context warnings, and cleanup UX into separate canonical issues so each can be triaged independently.

options.title: Reject Policy Slices
options.body: Accept only the retention cleanup bug and close the cadence/context-warning parts as not planned for core.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Through Linked PR Decisions
recommendation.body: Keep #38730 open while maintainers decide #90194 and #89739, then narrow or close the umbrella based on what lands.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight owns the active cadence-guardrail PR that introduces the main product/config decision left in the umbrella after the retention slice is separated.
